title: OSIsoft PI Coresight
overview: VULNERABILITY OVERVIEW CROSS-SITE REQUEST FORGERY (CSRF) CWE-352 This product contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that may allow access to the PI system. CVE-2017-9641 has been assigned to this vulnerability. A CVSS v3 base score of 7.1 has been calculated; the CVSS vector string is ( AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:L ). RESEARCHER OSIsoft reported this vulnerability to ICS-CERT. BACKGROUND Critical Infrastructure Sectors: Multiple Sectors Countries/Areas Deployed: Worldwide Company Headquarters Location: United States This product is provided subject to this  Notification  and this  Privacy & Use  policy.
